mu_name_from: Devias's object slot 36, which is the model index: every world but Lorencia runs its objects in one straight sequence, so type N is Object{N+1}.bmd and there is no friendlier name in the client than the number.
sheet_from: Data/Object3/*.OZJ and .OZT, from MuMain, decoded under a dv_ prefix. The prefix is load-bearing as nr_ is for Noria: assets/textures is one flat pool, and 39 of Object3's sheet names are already in it.
material_note:
house_stone_out: rubble stone.
fireplace_down: the soot-blackened hearth, cut out.
fireplace: an iron fire grille, cut out.
cutout_from: Each carries a real alpha channel, as decode_texture reports it.
effects_note: No arm in MuMain's WD_2DEVIAS switches: the hearth is cold in MU.
